g.text: The register records four calendar days of generator operation and 600 L in fuel columns; fuel burn was not independently metered.

g.text: *Circuit labels follow a placement reference; January 2025 placement and oxygen-serving connections still need confirmation.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #647684

g.text: Each pixel is a 120-second dashboard bucket. Mixed buckets prefer energized readings; gaps remain gaps. >23 V is a display screen,

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #647684

g.text: not a concentrator operating threshold. Electrical measurements do not establish oxygen flow, PSA operation, or clinical outcomes.
